title: Full-frame source recut with tracked subtitle blur
best_for: recomposing an approved vertical villa or tour video while preserving the complete original frame
removing burned-in titles and subtitles from selected human-free scenes and replacing them with clean editorial copy
music-led property or destination reels that do not need narration
avoid_when: the source aspect ratio does not match the delivery and reframing is required
a presenter, face, or reflection remains in every usable interval
source text crosses a moving subject and cannot be covered with a narrow tracked mask
the combined blur masks cover more than 20 percent of a frame or obscure the principal architecture
true object removal or scene reconstruction is required
source_contract: Use only owner-approved source video and record its URL and SHA-256
Inspect the complete source with CRV, one-second contact sheets, and exact boundary frames
Select only human-free intervals and recheck faces and reflections at both boundaries
Map each burned-in title and subtitle region per shot instead of assuming one global mask
Measure each proposed blur mask and reject the route when combined mask area exceeds 20 percent of the delivery frame
Use licensed music and remove all original source audio
creative_contract: Scale the complete original 9:16 frame directly to 1080x1920 without cropping, background fill, or invented scenery
Use narrow per-shot tracked blur masks over only the original title and subtitle regions
Prefer excluding a shot or using precise cleanup over hiding a central subject with blur
Add concise replacement subtitles on a readable editorial card inside mobile-safe margins
Build a smooth multi-shot sequence from approximately three-second scenes with short dissolves
Limit copy to visible property facts and mood; do not invent facilities, price, availability, or performance claims
Use vibe music only unless the requested recipe explicitly calls for narration
qa_contract: Verify source_frame_crop is false and the full original 9:16 frame is visible
Review the first and last frames of every shot to ensure source text does not escape a moving mask
Record per-shot mask area ratios and reject any frame whose combined blur exceeds 20 percent or covers the principal subject
Reject any visible presenter, face, reflection, original title, or original subtitle
Run full-playback review plus CRV sampled-frame review after the final encode
Require 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p at 30 fps with AAC audio and no black segments
Keep music near -18 to -14 LUFS with no clipping
hard_rejections: cropped foreground or blurred background fill described as full-frame preservation
a broad blur block that hides meaningful room or architectural detail
multiple blur bands that technically hide text but dominate the composition
original title or subtitle characters visible outside the tracked mask
a presenter, face, or reflection retained in a selected shot
original speech or source audio retained
generated facilities or unverified property claims

canonical_artifacts.role: source selection, blur-mask, composition, and safety contract
accepted technical and visual QA evidence

notes: Create a new dated project or output; never overwrite the accepted proof
Rebuild the interval and per-shot mask map for every new source
The sibling narrated and cropped outputs are alternatives, not this full-frame recipe

proof.disposition: Owner accepted the corrected full-frame, subtitle-blurred, music-led result as a reusable pattern on 2026-07-14
proof.qa: PASS: 26.9 seconds, 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p at 30 fps, AAC stereo, -15.4 LUFS, -2.5 dBFS true peak, no black segments, no humans, no source text, full original frame preserved

variants.distinction: Preserves the complete source frame; tracked blur removes source text; replacement subtitles and music provide the new edit.
